definitions: A place that is sheltered from direct sunlight.
Slight darkness caused by something blocking the light.
A particular variety of a colour.
A very small difference or amount.
A device for screening or covering something, especially a lamp or window.
examples: We sat in the shade of the tree.
The room was in deep shade.
Her dress was a lovely shade of blue.
There's a shade of doubt in my mind.
The shades of the past haunted him.
She pulled down the window shade.
